name: Offline field notes
purpose: Capture field notes offline and restore an owner-exported backup
differentiators: Timestamped notes with a reversible local backup workflow
acceptance: Create and edit a note offline, restart the app and recover the saved text
Export notes, delete local data and restore the same notes from the export
Run real device acceptance for both workflows using the project's test:e2e script and save actual screenshots
constraints: Use a CLI uni-app project with an owner-maintained native/android offline SDK host and app Gradle module
During the host build turn, run the existing real build:app script and integrate its generated App resources into the native host before verification; packaging only compiles that verified host
Adapt lint, test and test:e2e to the project's existing scripts; do not replace native acceptance with H5-only tests
Owner supplies the DCloud offline SDK, app identifiers and release signing; do not convert or rewrite an existing project
No accounts, tracking, hidden features or network dependency
